notes.title: Strik-9 enters Gamescom 2025!
notes.content:
[p]Strik-9 is participating online in our biggest event of the year so far - [url="https://www.gamescom.global/en"]Gamescom 2025[/url]! As part of our entry, we're updating the demo with four new features, including fresh songs and stages, shrines, ally skill trees and [b]Weaving[/b] - a whole new way to follow the beat.

Read on to see how rhythm is evolving with our latest updates.

[b]1. World Map, New Songs, New Stages[/b][/p][p]Conquer unique challenges across a world map. Play 3 different stages, each with its own 3 unique levels and environments that welcomes creativity in swapping Strik's moves and party comp. Finish each stage once and unlock "Stage Plus"! What's that you say? We'll leave that one for you to discover. ;)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638638/3f898c13964ae1715171cf8499ba3f3cc1ae453b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]2. ✨✨ Shrine Brighter ✨✨[/b][/p][p]Power up your DA-Moves with [b]Shrines[/b] scattered across the maps. Shrines provide bonuses that amp up Strik's DA-Moves, and lets you take on the hordes with reckless abandon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638638/669a847157b9cd5aac3ad352f607bd98056a79aa.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]3. Weave and Own the Rhythm[/b][/p][p]Nail that perfect hit and you’ll unlock an exciting window of opportunity. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638638/6b521a3dddc15c6fd4ed8b64ea6213929088c71c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Weaving[/b] is a new mechanic that lets you add a beat with an extra button press, effectively letting you remix in the midst of battle! Need that extra punch? Weave through![/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638638/ed54484b05f8eadc31be4f4b9176f2c4316ff8fc.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]4. Allies Grow With You[/b]
You think Muff and co will just loaf around and let Strik take the spotlight? Each ally now has their own Skill Tree, visualized as a stylish [b]vinyl disc[/b]. Unlock unique buffs, personalize your playstyle, and spin up the perfect team.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638638/1dfe35f14690ceddf2b13db0d1c3dce05b1bfaf4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That's it! Catch our live demo, join our communities in [url="https://bit.ly/strik9dc"]Discord[/url] and Steam!

[/p]

notes.title: Never dropping the ball, just the tunes
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![b]
[/b][/p][p]We’re beyond excited to announce the release of five original soundtracks from Strik-9 to YouTube, taking the music out of the game and into your playlist.
[/p][p]These tracks are more than just background music. They are the pulse of the underground, beckoning rhythm players to hit those perfect streaks and high scores.

Whether you’ve been a recent fan of our humble indie game or a new player to the genre, just now squeaking into the scene, these songs are bound to get your tail shaking.

Unleash your mid-week earworm with one of the songs in this volume - Heads or Tails.
[/p][previewyoutube="NMNPvI8oIfE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Check out the full playlist now! [url="https://bit.ly/strik9playlist"]https://bit.ly/strik9playlist[/url][/p]

notes.title: Strik 9: The Journey Begins
notes.content:
[p][b]What is "Strik-9", exactly?
[/b][/p][p]One month into what we are hoping would be a one-year journey to release, we have started building something strange, loud, and unapologetically rhythmic. Strik-9 is a rhythm bullet heaven game set in a world where rats are breaking out of a dystopian silence — not with weapons, but with glorious harmony. [/p][p]
At its core, this is a game about original electropunk music, high-energy combat, and stylish combo attacks we call "DA moves." If you're hitting your notes, you're dishing out destruction in perfect sync.[/p][p]
You can check out our announcement trailer here! [/p][previewyoutube="cif9aBbl5cA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
That's not all - we have two major announcements!

Firstly, Basika Games attended [url="https://www.pgdx.ph/ in Manila Philippines"]PGDX 2025[/url], Manila, Philippines, to feature Strik-9. It was fun spending the weekend with what we are hoping is now our new, budding community. We would like to thank everyone who came in early in the mornings, and to those who stayed in after event closing to play the game and give feedback. We are grateful.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/18260188724389957637/2B4067498E9839275FE4FE8537A8EA61E238C3F4/?imw=1024&imh=682&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true"][/img][/p][p]Even the Strik-9 gang can't help it. They just HAD to be there. Muff, being his adorable self, put up a leaderboard for all the high-scorers over the weekend![/p][p]  [img src="https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/16721495705063455586/7D618EFAD28F28732932C19D2C2EC5DFC3B70449/?imw=768&imh=1024&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true"][/img]  This brings us to our next announcement. To immortalize the accomplishment of our top players, we crafted new in-game skills as part of our PGDX patch. Namely, S-Amandil, S-ChaosCrafter and S-Melvin. ([url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3642210/view/532105554615599492"]Check out PGDX2025 Patch[/url]). [/p][p]
Stay posted for more updates![/p][p]
In the mean time, play the demo, turn up the volume, and pet a rat.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Join us on our Discord Community! [url="https://discord.gg/EKh7dcXn"]https://discord.gg/EKh7dcXn[/url][/p][p]Check out our socials! [url="https://linktr.ee/basikagames"]https://linktr.ee/basikagames[/url][/p][p][/p]
